"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_SLUG_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "scripts" / "slug.py"
+_TITLE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9]")
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_make_slug(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    title = params.get("title")
+    if not isinstance(title, str) or not 1 <= len(title) <= 80 or _TITLE_PATTERN.search(title) is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid title"}
+    # Pass the validated title as a discrete argument (never through a shell).
+    completed = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(_SLUG_SCRIPT), "--title", title],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=True,
+    )
+    slug = json.loads(completed.stdout)["slug"]
+    return 200, {"slug": slug}
